description: This is a C++ header promoting the IOmiProxy interface via the OmiProxy class implementation, defining methods related to managing crypted bundles and error listeners

classes.name: OmiProxy
classes.description: A concrete implementation of IOmiProxy that provides stub methods for managing encrypted bundles and error listeners

methods.name: bool mountCryptedBundle(const std::string & id,const std::string & rootfs_file_path,const std::string & config_json_path,std::string & bundlePath)
methods.description: Stub method to mount a crypted bundle given its id, root filesystem file path, and config json path

methods.name: bool umountCryptedBundle(const std::string & id)
methods.description: Stub method to unmount the crypted bundle identified by id

methods.name: long unsigned registerListener(const OmiErrorListener & listener,const void * cbParams)
methods.description: Method to register an error listener callback, returns a tag for later unregistration

methods.name: void unregisterListener(long unsigned tag)
methods.description: Method to unregister a previously registered error listener using its tag
